message: Ah, winter storms — the perfect excuse for a family group chat that spirals from weather updates to sharing old snow day memories. I always find it amusing how we go from, "Don't forget to grab extra batteries!" to, "Remember that time we built a snowman that looked like Uncle Joe?" It's nice to have a resource for tips on staying safe and cozy during these chilly events. What’s your favorite winter storm memory? ❄️
